{"subject":"Fraud-scoring workloads and node count","body":"Hi Dana,

Congrats on joining Brightwave AI. Northwind Payments, where you came from, runs fraud scoring on Astra DB, a workload where throughput and latency really matter.

I'm Oz, GTM Engineer at ScyllaDB. If Brightwave is planning similar high-throughput workloads, ScyllaDB offers higher throughput per node, which typically means fewer nodes and lower infrastructure cost. With IBM having completed its DataStax acquisition, it may also be a reasonable moment to review options.

Would it be useful to compare notes on how you're shaping the data layer at Brightwave?

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["champ_p12_a01"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_tco"],"context_fact_ids":["cf_ibm"]}
